Giant Savanna Trees

The giant trees. Step 0 picked the looks; step 2 shows the game's own shapes (the "Game shapes" switch), growing for real: wood never moves, it only lengthens and thickens. Every tree is made from one seed, so the same tree can be watched growing from a seedling to an ancient giant, dying, and falling. The little figures at the foot are for size: a player, a Matabele major and a harvester worker.

Drag to turn, right-drag to move, scroll to zoom
